summary: Pool members pull master-owned VLANs and shared-storage ISO metadata after join, matching existing NFS/SMB storage reconcile. API impact: new Core peer contracts for /api/v1/pool/networks* and /api/v1/pool/media*; Controller placement uses member_access for those resources.

guide.reason: Join workflow now covers VLAN and shared ISO pull as well as storage.

api.reason: Core peer APIs for pool networks and pool media list/get/access; NetworkRegistration and Media gain member_access; VLAN registration is forced to the pool master.

roadmap.reason: Website multi-host milestone records guest VLAN/shared-ISO member pull as built, with native acceptance and management-network staged apply still open.

state.reason: Pool VLAN desired state and shared ISO library metadata remain durable on the pool master Core journal; members journal local apply and report process-local access. Controller mirrors are disposable.
state.record: Master managed-vms journal for VLAN network-register and iso-import on pool-shared storage; member journals after pull; member_access observations in master Core memory rebuilt from authenticated peer POSTs.

verification.method: Ran go test for agent pool network/media reconcile, focused controller VLAN/media/pool checks, protocol and vmhost packages; ran documentation gate and repository privacy check.
